title: What a school looks like
offscreen: Walk past the real school one afternoon and look at the gate and the playground from outside.

spots.label: The entrance
spots.say: This is where you come in in the morning. A teacher is there to say hello.

spots.label: The coat pegs
spots.say: Every child has their own peg with their name or a picture.

spots.label: The classroom
spots.say: Low tables, small chairs, lots of colours. Here you play and learn.

spots.label: The toilets
spots.say: They're small, made for children. You can go whenever you need to, just say so.

spots.label: The dining hall
spots.say: Everyone eats together. If you don't like something, you can say so.

spots.label: The playground
spots.say: Here you run and play outside when it isn't raining.

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
